tool_input.description: Test JsonReader top-level scalar behavior without lenient

result:
All 58 tests pass.

Created two self-contained JUnit 3.8 test classes (matching the project's existing style):

- `gson/src/test/java/com/google/gson/stream/JsonReaderAgentTest.java` — covers object/array parsing, nested structures, number precision boundaries (`Long.MAX_VALUE`/`MIN_VALUE`, int/long overflow), string escapes, lenient vs. strict mode (NaN/Infinity, unquoted/single-quoted values, non-execute prefix, multiple top-level values), `skipValue`, `getPath`, malformed/premature-EOF errors, and closed-reader behavior.
- `gson/src/test/java/com/google/gson/stream/JsonWriterAgentTest.java` — covers basic/nested emission, indentation, HTML-safe escaping, `serializeNulls`, lenient NaN/Infinity handling, dangling-name and nesting errors, incomplete-document close failure, null string/number values, raw `jsonValue`, method chaining, and closed-writer behavior.

Both compile at `-source 8` and run clean via `./_tools/test.sh` (58/58 passing).
